currentCard.prompt: В каком десятилетии игра Pac-Man впервые появилась на игровых автоматах?

answers.note: Первую версию Spacewar! Стив Рассел написал в 1961 году; весной 1962-го коллеги существенно её доработали.
Идею Pong Нолан Бушнелл предложил в 1972 году, а Аллан Алкорн затем создал аркадный прототип.
В Японии Pac-Man был известен под названием Puck Man.
Sony выпустила PlayStation на японский рынок 3 декабря 1994 года.

currentCard.explanation: Pac-Man впервые появился на игровых автоматах в 1980 году, то есть в 1980-е годы. В Японии игру знали под названием Puck Man.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Manual L12 explicitly dates first arcade appearance to1980, which belongs to1980–1989, so slot2 alone is correct; the museum L202 independently fixes1980. All four labels are comparable consecutive decades, with no grammatical giveaway. However, identifying the first-appearance decade rather than merely recognizing Pac-Man is thematic chronology: the boundary1979/1980 cannot be settled from the recognizable character or generic retro appearance. Exact CURRENT does not satisfy frozen adult EASY.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Sentence1 follows manual L12 and elementary conversion1980→1980s. Sentence2 follows museum L199’s Japan name Puck Man. Exactly2 sentences, names the correct answer explicitly, no claim that Puck Man was the name everywhere.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Первую версию Spacewar! Стив Рассел написал в 1961 году; весной 1962-го коллеги существенно её доработали.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: CHM Russell L77 states first version1961 and significant spring1962 improvements by Samson, Edwards and Graetz. The Russian sentence preserves first-version versus collaborative-revision distinction and places a concrete video-game event inside its own1960s decade.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Идею Pong Нолан Бушнелл предложил в 1972 году, а Аллан Алкорн затем создал аркадный прототип.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Pong museum L203 attributes the idea to Bushnell in1972, then an assigned prototype to Alcorn within months. The note preserves those separate roles and provides a real1970s event for that decade option.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: В Японии Pac-Man был известен под названием Puck Man.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Museum L199 says Pac-Man was known as Puck Man in Japan. This gives an additional fact about the same game at its debut context beyond which decade it appeared; it is not merely a restatement of1980s. Overlap with explanation is allowed.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Sony выпустила PlayStation на японский рынок 3 декабря 1994 года.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Sony chapter L191 explicitly introduces PlayStation in winter1994; L193 places market launch on December3 of that year with yen pricing and domestic commercial context. Sony’s Japan console launch is a concrete own-decade1990s event; the note does not attribute that event to Pac-Man.

absoluteLevel.assessment: MEDIUM-like thematic chronology; frozen level unchanged
absoluteLevel.ground: Removing Pac-Dots/Power Pellets resolves the English-terminology defect, but replacing the MAIN with first arcade-debut decade changes the required knowledge rather than establishing EASY. An adult may know Pac-Man as a yellow retro-game mascot without knowing whether it began in the late1970s or early1980s. Those neighbouring eras both plausibly contain early arcade hits; the actual1980 debut lies exactly on their boundary. The prompt supplies no general-knowledge or reasoning clue that settles this. This fits thematic historical familiarity (MEDIUM) more closely than broadly known adult EASY. Manual L12 proves1980; museum L199–L208 proves cultural reach, not that broad adults know the debut decade. A wider interval and fame alone do not establish EASY.
